# Detailed Meeting Notes

## Meeting #1

**Date:** 13 September 2026

### Agenda

- Research updates
- Publication schedule
- New project discussions

### Discussion Summary

- Assigning Tasks
- ICML and ICLR target

### Decisions Made

## Meeting #2

**Date:** 19 September 2026

### Agenda

- Meeting with Keza on Agentic Memory
- Discussing paper roadblocks

### Discussion Summary

- Using Qwen to map from vector space to text in decoder step.
- Questions on methods/attributes in the classes.

### Decisions Made

1. Tourad joins Fiifi in curriculum.
2. Keza and Fasseu work on their research ideas.

## Meeting #3

**Date:** 26 September 2026

### Agenda

- Update on [AAAI paper](https://github.com/ArnolFokam/research-publications/tree/main/AAAI2027)
- Updated results on the memory method for LoCoMo

### Discussion Summary

- The very first [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00420) which was entirely theoretical got the final reviews this week and though the final decision was a rejection from the conference the feedback was very helpful.
- We checked with everyone on their commitments to assigned tasks and the goal.
- There were some technical deepdives into specific methodolodies on the ongoing research work with Fasseu and results for LoCoMo were shared.

### Decisions Made

1. The feedback gotten on the AAAI paper will be used to improve the paper and repurpose it for a submission to an ICLR workshop.

## Meeting #4

**Date:** 03 October 2026

### Agenda

- Feedback and direction for new [learning and development platform](https://github.com/fiifidawson/research-gym) 
- Update on WiML @ NeurIPS 
- Memory work Update with Keza
- Repurposing AAAI paper

### Discussion Summary

- Our learning repo is live and has an easy and interesting methodology to get everyone up to speed with the playground, we spoke on how to make everyone a meaningful contributor and encourage manually working throught the tasks rather than vibe coding.
- No update from NeurIPS funding yet but we are encouraged to start visa processing now.
- Keza displayed the benchmark results o several models and the feedback was to get it in a table for better viewing. Arnol also suggested to move to a RAG architecture
- Fasseu wasn't around for the repositioning talk but the workshop is the end goal.    

### Decisions Made

1. Everyone needs to checkout and follow through with the learning and development site, a deadline will help motivate us.
